_about: The barb in full plate (gear_test/in/barb_fullplate.png). 8 body views + 12 close-ups, chosen from the bare barb's patch report (2026-11-02): one view per hand (the second added 0.13-0.19 % of the texture), no side-face views (both failed to align on the barb), no separate foot views (small at sprite scale; the body views paint them), pelvis_back dropped (legs_back frames the hips from behind too), no 1024 head views (face_front and head_back replace them).
_res: part_res 1024: the 4096 texture holds at most ~260 px across the face, 300-400 for hands/head, ~1000 for the legs (barb UV-id measure, 2026-11-02); 2880 was 3-11x more than the model keeps. regions.arm: the arm frame cut the pauldron tops.
_model: Leonardo nano-banana-2 (quality_test.py on the barb's face, 2026-11-02): $0.039 and silhouette match 1.00, vs gpt-image-2 medium 1024 $0.099 / 0.96, high 2880 $0.758 / 0.93, gpt-image-1-mini $0.023 / 0.72 (off-style). quality applies only when provider is openai.
subject: barbarian hero in full plate armour
design: a bearded barbarian in full plate armour: bright silvery steel plates with darker steel edges and round rivets, brown leather straps with steel buckles, a brown leather belt with a steel buckle, a pointed steel fauld plate with chevron lines at the front, overlapping tasset plates over the hips, articulated steel gauntlets and sabatons; bare head with warm tanned skin, dark brown hair tied in a top knot and a full dark brown beard
match_part: steel, leather, skin, hair and beard colours
match_body: steel, leather, skin, hair and beard colours and painting style
body_paint: Paint it in the hand-painted style of image 3: every steel plate a clean, readable shape with a light silvery centre, darker steel towards its edges, a crisp bright highlight along each plate rim and a dark line where plates overlap; round rivets; leather straps darker brown with stitching and steel buckles; the face painterly with crisp eyes, nose and mouth and bold beard and hair locks.
part_variation: with painterly variation (lighter and cooler on the steel high points, darker where plates overlap and in the gaps)
finish_part: Evenly lit: no cast shadows, no directional light, no mirror reflections and no white glare; the steel reads as steel through value contrast between plate centres, rims and overlaps.
finish_body: Evenly lit: no cast shadows, no directional light, no mirror reflections and no white glare; the steel reads as steel through value contrast between plate centres, rims and overlaps.
